doc: Child over parent: scalar replaced, nested elements merged by name, li appended, new elements appended at the end; attributes of the parent (Name, Abstract, Foo) are NOT inherited.
name: inherit-basic-merge

doc: Children of fields marked XmlInheritanceAllowDuplicateNodes (here forcedTraits) are appended like li; the same shape under another name is merged.
name: inherit-allow-duplicate-nodes

doc: Inherit="False" on a nested node discards the parent's content of that node; the Inherit attribute itself is dropped.
name: inherit-false-nested

doc: Quirk: with Inherit="false" on the def node the cloned parent's attributes survive (Name, Abstract) and the child's are appended.
name: inherit-false-root-keeps-parent-attrs

doc: An empty child element: removes the parent's text (no element children) but keeps the parent's element children.
name: inherit-empty-element

doc: Quirk (Mono probe): a child that holds text replaces the parent's content, but only the FIRST child node of the parent is removed (live list).
name: inherit-text-over-multichild-quirk

doc: Grandparent, parent, child in any file order: resolved top-down; the parent chain is recorded.
name: inherit-chain-three-levels

doc: A cycle is reported for every member; the members stay unresolved and the defs are built from the raw nodes (with a not-resolved error each).
name: inherit-cycle

doc: A missing parent is an error; the node still becomes a def, unmerged.
name: inherit-missing-parent

doc: A child sees the parent with the highest load order that is not after its own mod; a parent that only exists in a LATER mod is invisible.
name: inherit-parent-by-load-order

doc: A Name used twice inside one mod: the second is not registered (error); the same Name in another mod is fine and wins for that mod's children.
name: inherit-duplicate-name-same-mod

doc: Two non-list nodes with one name in a child: reported; the merge applies both in order, the last text wins.
name: inherit-duplicate-node-name-error

doc: Abstract is read on the ORIGINAL node, case-insensitively as a value, case-sensitively as an attribute name; it is never inherited.
name: abstract-not-created

doc: Type resolution: element name or Class attribute (not inherited), case-insensitive for namespace-qualified and ignored-namespace names, short names of non-ignored namespaces fail; a subclass def lives in the databases of all its ancestors.
name: class-attribute-and-type-names

doc: Databases are per type and include subclasses: an AmmoDef named like a ThingDef replaces it in DefDatabase<ThingDef>; inside one mod the second def of a name is skipped in the ancestor database.
name: duplicates-across-types

doc: MayRequire (all of) and MayRequireAnyOf (any of) on top-level nodes: ids are trimmed and case-insensitive, an EMPTY MayRequire never matches, an unmet MayRequire on a parent keeps it from being registered.
name: mayrequire-top-level

doc: li entries of the `operations` and `mods` lists honour MayRequire / MayRequireAnyOf (skipped when unmet).
name: mayrequire-in-patch-lists

doc: Later mods override earlier defs with the same defName; the winner is appended, so database order changes.
name: merge-load-order-and-override

doc: Two defs with one defName inside ONE mod: the first stays, the second is skipped with an error. Files of a folder are visited in sorted order here (OS order in the game).
name: duplicate-in-same-mod

doc: LoadFolders.xml (v1.6 with IfModActive, IfModNotActive, IfModActiveAll; later entries have priority and load first) and the version-folder fallbacks (closest older folder, Common, root; an exact 1.6 folder wins).
name: load-folders-and-version-folders

doc: A file in a higher-priority load folder hides the same relative path in a lower one (no duplicate error); other files of the lower folder still load.
name: file-dedup-between-folders

doc: A root element other than Defs is an error but its children still load; an unparseable file is skipped; an element that is no Def type is skipped.
name: defs-bad-root-parse-error-unknown-type

doc: Add appends by default; order Prepend keeps the order of the value children; a non-matching xpath fails.
name: patch-add-order

doc: Insert with several value children REVERSES them in both orders: each copy is inserted directly before (Prepend, walking the value backwards) or directly after (Append, walking forwards) the target node.
name: patch-insert-order

doc: Replace puts the value children where the node was; Remove deletes; both fail on no match.
name: patch-replace-remove

doc: A def node replaced by a patch loses its asset: provenance is empty and the def goes into the database after all mod defs ('Patches' source).
name: patch-replace-whole-def

doc: AttributeAdd fails when the attribute exists, AttributeSet always succeeds (creates or overwrites), AttributeRemove fails when absent.
name: patch-attribute-ops

doc: SetName creates a new element with the same inner XML and DROPS all attributes.
name: patch-setname

doc: AddModExtension creates modExtensions at the END of the def when missing, otherwise appends to it.
name: patch-addmodextension

doc: Test, Conditional truth table and Sequence: a failing step stops the sequence but the steps before it stay applied (no rollback).
name: patch-conditional-test-sequence

doc: success=Invert / Always / Never rewrite the result after the work was done (Never still applies the change).
name: patch-success-modes

doc: FindMod matches the display NAME of an active mod (exact, case-sensitive), any entry is enough; a missing branch means success.
name: patch-findmod

doc: An unknown or missing Class becomes the base PatchOperation: it fails (and logs) but success=Always/Invert still applies; inside a Sequence it stops the sequence.
name: patch-unknown-class

doc: XPath context is the document: relative 'Defs/...' works, '//' works, attribute nodes can be tested, text() nodes can be replaced.
name: patch-xpath-forms

doc: All Defs of all mods are merged BEFORE any patch runs (a patch can target a def of a later mod); patches then run mod by mod in load order, file by file.
name: patch-order-across-mods

doc: Nodes created by patches have no mod: as children they pick the null-mod parent first, else the LOWEST load order; as parents they are the fallback for mod children.
name: patch-created-nodes-have-no-mod

doc: Exceptions inside an operation (missing value, invalid or non-node-set xpath) are logged and the operation counts as failed; nested ones abort the enclosing Sequence.
name: patch-exceptions

doc: Class names are matched case-insensitively (also with the Verse. prefix) and field names fall back to a case-insensitive match with an error.
name: patch-class-case-tolerance
